display.purpose: The hero headline, one phrase per line, ending in a Signal Blue full stop; the role line sits above it.

headline.purpose: Section titles: plain words that match the nav, a step below the hero headline. Only About's title carries an italic word.

title.purpose: Research card headings; smaller titles step down to about 1.1rem/600.

lead.purpose: Opening paragraphs of About and Research, and the lead news item.

body.purpose: Paragraphs in Soft Ink, 58-62ch, tabular numerals.

numeral.purpose: Scholar numbers in About; the first one in Ink Blue.

label.purpose: Dates, captions and metadata in Muted Ink.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Hover lift for research cards, award cards and element tiles; the scan monitor at rest.

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: A selected element tile; combined with soft on hover.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrances, presses, reveals, hover lifts. The default curve.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Things moving on screen: the nav underline, the clip-path image reveal, view transitions.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: Cards and tiles on fine-pointer hover; reduced motion keeps only the shadow.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: translateY(16px) + fade over 600ms ease-out; stagger step 50ms
motion.purpose: First view of blocks and groups; reduced motion keeps the fade.

motion.name: image-reveal
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0) over 800ms ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Figures uncovered from the top on first view.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Publication filtering; instant when keyboard-triggered; a new click skips the running transition, and the overlay never takes pointer events.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Reviewing venues; pauses on hover and through a toggle.

motion.name: parallax-spring
motion.purpose: Hero portrait pointer parallax, fine pointers only.

motion.name: results-pill
motion.value: fade + rise 8px over 200ms ease-out via @starting-style; exits the same way
motion.purpose: The floating results button in Publications; reduced motion keeps only the fade.

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: Primary action, such as Download CV. Ink pill that turns Powder Blue on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 48px; padding: 0 1.4rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: var(--font-sans, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-weight: 550; font-size: 0.975rem; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-solid { background: var(--ink, #10141a); color: var(--bg, #f4f6f8); } .ds-btn-solid:hover { background: var(--accent, #a8c8e8); color: var(--on-accent, #10141a); }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 1.4rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d3dbe3); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #10141a); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-weight: 550; font-size: 0.975rem; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #10141a); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 40px circle for the theme toggle, the menu, rail arrows and pause controls.
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d3dbe3); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #10141a); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #10141a); } .ds-icon-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Publication filters. Hairline pill; fills with Ink when pressed.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 38px; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d3dbe3); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #3f4852); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #10141a); color: var(--ink, #10141a); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink, #10141a); color: var(--bg, #f4f6f8); border-color: var(--ink, #10141a); }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Paper status and venue labels; the accent variant is a Powder Blue fill.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d3dbe3); color: var(--ink-2, #3f4852); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tag-accent { border-color: transparent; background: var(--accent, #a8c8e8); color: var(--on-accent, #10141a); }

components.name: Element Tile
components.description: Periodic-table filter tile. Families differ by value; unmatched tiles turn to outlines and zero-count tiles to dashed outlines, never faded.
components.css: .ds-els { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 96px); gap: 8px; } .ds-el { aspect-ratio: 1; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr 2.4em; align-items: start; padding: 8px 9px; text-align: left; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: var(--font-sans, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-el-count { font-size: 0.68rem; opacity: 0.75; line-height: 1; } .ds-el-symbol { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1; align-self: center; } .ds-el-name { font-size: 0.69rem; line-height: 1.25; opacity: 0.85; align-self: end; } .ds-el-imaging { background: var(--ink, #10141a); color: var(--bg, #f4f6f8); } .ds-el-learning { background: var(--accent, #a8c8e8); color: var(--on-accent, #10141a); } .ds-el-geometry { background: var(--el-sunk, #d2d6dc); color: var(--ink, #10141a); } .ds-el-practice { background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #10141a); border-color: var(--line, #d3dbe3); } .ds-el[aria-pressed="true"] { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg, #f4f6f8), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2); } .ds-el:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 0 rgb(16 20 26 / 0.04), 0 12px 32px -18px rgb(36 52 70 / 0.3)); } .ds-el[aria-pressed="true"]:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg, #f4f6f8), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2), var(--shadow, 0 12px 32px -18px rgb(36 52 70 / 0.3)); } .ds-el:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-el:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-el[data-unmatched], .ds-el[data-empty] { background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #3f4852); border-color: var(--line, #d3dbe3); } .ds-el[data-empty] { color: var(--ink-3, #5c6773); border-style: dashed; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 0.85rem; max-width: 360px; padding: clamp(1.4rem, 2.5vw, 2rem); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface, #fcfdfe); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d3dbe3); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #10141a); transition: transform 200ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), box-shadow 200ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 0 rgb(16 20 26 / 0.04), 0 12px 32px -18px rgb(36 52 70 / 0.3)); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-2, #3f4852); line-height: 1.6; } .ds-card-link { justify-self: start; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--ink, #10141a); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d3dbe3); padding-bottom: 2px; } .ds-card-link:hover { color: var(--accent-ink, #2b5f8c); border-color: currentColor; } .ds-card-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--nav-bg, rgb(244 246 248 / 0.8)); backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(140%); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d3dbe3); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--ink, #10141a); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-glyph { width: 22px; height: 22px; background: conic-gradient(from 146deg at 50% 4%, var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2) 0deg 68deg, transparent 68deg); mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 4%, #000 0 95%, transparent 96%); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 1.6rem; margin-left: auto; font-size: 0.925rem; } .ds-nav-links a { color: var(--ink-2, #3f4852); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.4rem 0; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--ink, #10141a); } .ds-nav-links a[aria-current] { color: var(--ink, #10141a); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 44px; padding: 0 1.15rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink, #10141a); color: var(--bg, #f4f6f8); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 0.925rem; font-weight: 550; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift, 0 1px 0 rgb(16 20 26 / 0.04), 0 28px 48px -26px rgb(36 52 70 / 0.45)); transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-mark, #5b8fc2); outline-offset: 3px; }

keyCharacteristics: One hue (powder blue) on cool blue-grey neutrals; every neutral leans toward the accent's hue.
A single family, Helvetica Neue, with a self-hosted TeX Gyre Heros fallback.
Flat surfaces with 1px hairlines; cards lift onto a soft shadow on hover.
Pills for things you press, 14px corners for things that hold content.
Real photography and real research figures only.
Light and dark themes with the same structure; the scan monitor is always dark.
Motion uses strong ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`), presses scale to 0.97, and every looping animation can be paused.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Powder blue is the only hue. Families and states are told apart by value (ink, blue fill, sunk grey, outline), never by adding a colour. The four element families prove that it works.

rules.name: The Three Blues Rule
rules.body: Fill blue is for areas, Signal Blue for marks of 1–3px, Ink Blue for text. Never set text in fill blue on a light background.

rules.name: The Monitor Rule
rules.body: Anything that shows imaging (the scan, the photo lightbox) sits on Monitor Black in both themes, like a real screen.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Helvetica Neue only. No serif, no monospace, no display face from a template library.

rules.name: The One Personal Heading Rule
rules.body: Section titles are plain and say what the nav says. Only About's title, "Hi, I'm *Chiara*.", carries an italic word (same family, 400, with descender room). Never add a second.

rules.name: The Proof Outranks Outreach Rule
rules.body: Paper titles are never smaller than talk titles, and the contact email (at most 2.25rem) sits below the section titles, never the largest type on the page.

rules.name: The Lift-on-Hover Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat until a fine pointer reaches them; then they rise 2px onto the Soft shadow over 200ms. Touch never lifts. Reduced motion keeps the shadow and drops the rise.

rules.name: The Physical Object Rule
rules.body: A shadow at rest means "this sits in front of the page": the monitor, the floating results button. Nothing else casts one until it is hovered.

dos: **Do** use Ink Blue (#2b5f8c) for any blue text, and Signal Blue (#5b8fc2) for focus rings, underlines and marks of 1–3px.
**Do** tell states and categories apart by value (Ink, Powder Blue fill, Sunk Surface, outline) before reaching for anything else.
**Do** give every pressable element `transform: scale(0.97)` on `:active` at 160ms with `cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`.
**Do** gate hover motion behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`, and give every animation a reduced-motion variant that keeps the fade and drops the movement.
**Do** put a pause control on anything that moves continuously (WCAG 2.2.2).
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px on coarse pointers.
**Do** theme browser surfaces from the palette: text selection in Powder Blue; a 2px Signal Blue focus ring with a 3px offset; scrollbars tinted from Ink; tabular numerals.
**Do** keep paper titles at least as large as talk titles, and the contact email at most 2.25rem (below the section titles).
**Do** use real photographs of the owner and real research figures.
donts: **Don't** add a second hue, a gradient accent or a purple-blue glow.
**Don't** set text in Powder Blue (#a8c8e8) on a light background.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface. The earlier Bricolage Grotesque and Geist pairing was rejected for looking AI-generated, and no serif or monospace face belongs here either.
**Don't** use `transition: all` or animate layout properties. Use transform, opacity, clip-path and box-shadow; `block-size` is allowed only for the details accordion.
**Don't** lift anything on touch, or move anything under reduced motion.
**Don't** give a card a shadow at rest unless it sits in front of the page (the monitor, the floating results button).
**Don't** dim an active control with opacity; switch it to an outline so its text stays at 4.5:1 or more.
**Don't** nest cards, or build a section out of same-size icon-and-heading cards.
